title: Endel continues to soothe and focus my brain
content: I found Endel when it first came out, 2017 or so. I struggled with technical issues on my ancient phone but loved when it worked. While off grid in the woods for 2 weeks, this became my soundtrack on my iphone 12 mini, which I still use. At that point endel worked offline, with the most basic sounds free and no 10 minute limit. It was incredible and non-invasive in the natural space. I also used it at night on low volume to warn the cougars and bears of my presence. I didn't die! Yay! I finally purchased a year of it now, in 2026, because I need it more than ever being finally diagnosed with adhd and autism. I love focus, move and sleep-I love the way it supports my odd hours or focus and helps me rest easily for sleep. When I turn it off, I almost feel like I was being physically pushed and then, like the push is gone when I turn it off. It actually supports focus, aligns with neuroplasticity experiments and is simply my fave thing to listen to for all activities! It's expensive and I wish it was more accessible for lower income people. But even the free version is super helpful. LOVE IT!

title: Ein wirklich gelungenes Programm
content:
Die App verbindet die physischen Daten des Nutzers (wenn eine Smartwatch benutzt wird) mit den kosmischen (zirkardianrhythmisch) - und zwar regionalspezifisch (Wetterapp und Standortdaten). Sie spielt Klänge über einen Synthesizer ab. Vier Klangprogramme bilden die eingespeisten Daten ab. Dabei gibt es vier frei wählbare Klangvarianten - je nachdem, was man erreichen will: Beruhigung (Rest) Konzentration (Fokus), Ab- oder Anspannung (Go to) und schließlich Schlaf (Sleep). Es gibt im Internet eine Variante mit Gesang. Die sollte in die App integriert werden. Interessant wäre sicher auch die Kopplung mit einem Emotions-/ Gehirnwellensensor (Stirnband). Drittens schlage ich vor, dass ein Expertenmodus eingebaut wird, der Nutzungsempfehlungen und Verhaltensempfehlungen sowie persönliche Gesundheitstipps produziert. Die jährlichen Kosten für die Nutzung der aktuellen Version sind moderat. Man kann die App auch ohne Anbindung an individuelle Daten nutzen. Dann sind die Klänge bei verschiedenen Personen gleich.

title: Definitely helps my ADHD focus issues at least a bit!
content:
This app hasn’t been a transformative, life-changing discovery like some ads suggest, but I’ve been using it for over half a year now and I definitely notice some improvement in my focus and attention when using it! Exactly how much of a difference depends on the day/time/circumstances, but it’s enough that this has become a regular ADHD management tool for me, for everything from studying to working on creative projects, really anything that I need a focus boost for. 

The most significant improvement for me happens when my brain is hitting that boredom-burnout point on long assignments or study sessions. Putting on the music in this app helps get my brain out of the disengaged/distracted slump, or at least reduces how bad it is. If I was already having a relatively good focus day I don’t notice as much impact; I’m sure there’s still at least little, but it’s less obvious. 

As a side note, I’m really glad the app has the thumbs down button permanently skip songs. I have some misophonia and there have been several songs that had just the wrong combination of sounds in order to trigger it, but being able to simply remove those songs from rotation means that’s not a serious problem. 

I do wish there was a way to have playlists in addition to the favorites library though…

title: Limited
content: Let me preface by saying I am highly sensitive. I had hoped that the app could help me to focus more than traditional music. However, the music selection was limited, there was no option to provide feedback or make “sound” customizations other than setting a sensitivity level. For me, I found sounds like static and crinkling to be anxiety triggering and wish I could have filtered out layers of such sound as I can with other sleep soundscape apps. No value found for me, especially for a paid subscription required app.

title: Too expensive subscription
content: I’ve paid the annual subscription ($50) for about 3 years now. A few days ago they doubled that price, and now EVERY day when I open the app, it says my sub is “expired” and I need to pick a new, more expensive plan. I can “restore purchases” on my profile and it says “you have 214 days left” - each day it is counting down, but I shouldn’t have to go through that step 200 more times to complete my subscription in peace. App is great, music is wonderful, but the PRICE IS TOO HIGH. I won’t be renewing, I just hope they fix the “expired” problem so I don’t have to restore purchase on a daily basis :(
